Browser runtime vendor notices

The JavaScript files in this directory are pinned browser runtime dependencies.
They are served from the same origin as go.mod Lens. Bundled ESM import
specifiers were rewritten to sibling files in this directory.

Packages:

- htmx.org 2.0.8, 0BSD
- ngraph.graph 20.1.1, BSD-3-Clause
- ngraph.forcelayout 3.3.1, BSD-3-Clause
- ngraph.svg 0.11.0, MIT
- ngraph.events 1.4.0 and 1.2.2, BSD-3-Clause
- ngraph.merge 1.0.0, MIT
- ngraph.random 1.1.0, BSD-3-Clause
- rbush 3.0.1, MIT
- quickselect 2.0.0, ISC
